Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring DSHS to investigate fraud and to cooperate with fraud investigations.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to detection and investigation of fraud by thedepartment of social and health services; and adding a new section tochapter 43.20A RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.20A RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The department shall investigate any discrepancy, including anyoverpayment or fraud, and shall report all fraudulent activity to locallaw enforcement. Fraud includes overpayments where it is found by thedepartment that the provider or recipient failed to disclose ormisrepresents material facts. When evidence or other informationcompiled as part of fraud investigations conducted under this chapterindicate that there is any potential for criminal violations, allfindings, evidence, and supporting information shall be transferred ina timely manner to law enforcement officers in the county in which thefraud was allegedly committed. The county law enforcement officersshall have access to department fraud investigators and any additional p. 1 SB 5293personnel or information they may need. Department fraud investigatorsshall cooperate in the investigation and prosecution of crimes.
